# Ian Dahlin

> Lead Software Engineer at Brooks Building Solutions (Jacksonville, Florida). Builds desktop applications, automation platforms, and engineering-grade simulation tools. Co-author of TopoRec (IEEE/CVF WACV 2026). B.S. in Computer Science, University of North Florida, May 2025 (AI & Machine Learning concentration).

## Experience
- Lead Software Engineer, Brooks Building Solutions (Nov 2025 – present): leads an engineering team building a C#/.NET desktop application that generates HVAC unit schematic and wiring diagrams, bills of materials, parts and points lists, and sequences of operation; architects engineering simulation tools.
- Software Engineer, Brooks Building Solutions (May 2025 – Nov 2025): internal tools and web applications that automate company processes; reusable diagram tools and templates.
- Machine Learning Research Assistant, University of North Florida (Aug 2024 – May 2025): 3D object classification on LiDAR point clouds (PointNet, PointNet++), 91% accuracy; co-developed TopoRec.

## Publication
- [TopoRec: Point Cloud Recognition Using Topological Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.18725), IEEE/CVF WACV 2026, co-author.

## Projects
- AeroAtlas: LLM-powered travel itinerary planner; Audience Choice Award, UNF School of Computing Symposium.
- [Object detection on a Raspberry Pi](https://github.com/Teseife/Custom-YOLOv5-RaspberryPi): custom YOLOv5 + OpenCV on low-power hardware.
- [Rapidly-exploring random trees](https://github.com/yeahian/Rapidly-Exploring-Random-Trees): path planning through obstacle courses.

## Skills
- Languages: C#, Java, Python, C, SQL, MATLAB, XAML, HTML, CSS
- Frameworks & libraries: .NET, React, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Open3D
- Tools & platforms: Git, GitHub, AutoCAD, Blender, Linux, Unix, LiDAR processing
